question: What default requests per minute and tokens per minute does a new Nebius Token Factory account get, and are they per model? No first-party page gives a per-model table, and the published baselines differ: the Starter Plan row reads '400K TPM / 600 RPM baseline. Burst capacity on request.' (nebius.com/services/token-factory/enterprise-grade-inference, sha256:a136cbd33e913e698414061c8a4d21dc8a88edcbfa570fe235a8a893adf93224); the rate-limits page shows a table labelled a visual example with a 60 RPM and 400,000 TPM baseline, says 'Every user is provided with a default rate limit cap.' and puts the defaults in the console at tokenfactory.nebius.com/project/rate-limits (sha256:7f8c040889c8964058330c70969257846441205ba1aad6fe491bb6ca1606038d); a Nebius blog post written under the AI Studio name reads 'up to 400K tokens per minute (tpm) by default, up to 200K–100K tpm per model' (nebius.com/blog/posts/launch-production-agents-at-scale, sha256:97046e68c8647e0f67ac86a03b7c82a241d7c66eff1f95842324ff884322a1bf). An account holder can read the live values from the x-ratelimit-limit-requests and x-ratelimit-limit-tokens response headers.
why: unverified: behind a sign-up that requires a bank card; the console page answered an SPA shell with no values to an anonymous read
